Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Compact demo window proposal for Northstar: chunked walkthrough

Kim & Vanessa,

Quick note before I ping the partner: Northstar is asking for a single 60-minute slot but their core teams span APAC ops and US execs. To keep the session tight and increase attendance, I propose we offer a compact, chunked demo: two focused blocks (25 min product walkthrough + 20 min SI technical deep-dive) with a 15-min buffer for questions and recording handoff. That lets APAC watch the exec + product block live and US folks join for the technical deep-dive, or we can run the second block as a repeat.

Attachments: agenda-compact-demo.pdf (draft), mvp-demo-plan.xlsx (mapping by persona)

A few asks:
- Can Kimberly cover the 1st block (product highlights + cost/latency outcomes)?
- Vanessa — can you coordinate Orbit Systems (SI) availability for the technical 20-min deep-dive?
- If we propose two adjacent windows (08:00 UTC / 15:00 UTC) are those acceptable as a single "compact" option for the customer?

Goal: propose one consolidated invite that preserves an exec-friendly narrative while giving engineering a compact, actionable deep-dive. I’ll draft the external email once you confirm roles.

Thanks,
Michael

Subject: Compact demo window proposal for Northstar: chunked walkthrough

Hi Alice / Jake / Sam,

Thanks again for the quick sync yesterday. To make scheduling straightforward for Northstar’s distributed teams, we’d like to propose a compact demo format that keeps the whole session under 60 minutes while serving both exec and technical audiences. Proposed structure (60 minutes total):

- 0–25 min: Executive + product overview (Redwood) — ROI, multi-environment inference, and demo of a 3-step flow focused on latency/cost trade-offs.
- 25–45 min: SI technical deep-dive (Orbit Systems) — architecture, infra considerations, and hands-on gating items.
- 45–60 min: Q&A / next steps (all) and record/links handoff.

We can run those as two adjacent windows (Option A) so APAC joins the first live and US joins the second, or run both blocks back-to-back for a single audience. Proposed times (please reply with availability):
- Option A (APAC-first): 2026-06-02 08:00–09:00 UTC (exec-heavy) / repeat 15:00–16:00 UTC (tech-heavy)
- Option B (single compact): 2026-06-02 15:00–16:00 UTC (all attendees)

Attachments: agenda-compact-demo.pdf (draft) and a short MVP mapping (mvp-demo-plan.xlsx).

Could you confirm: a) preferred option, b) which Orbit/System SI rep should lead the deep-dive (Jake, is that you?), and c) any agenda items to add for compliance or procurement (Sam)?

If this works I’ll send a single invite with both blocks and an option to register for the tech-only repeat.

Best,
Michael Grant
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Compact demo window proposal for Northstar: chunked walkthrough

Michael — thanks for the clear options. Orbit can do the 25–45 min technical block for either slot. A couple notes from my side:

- For the technical block I’ll need ~10 minutes to show the SI integration checklist (networking ACLs, KMS flow, VPC peering notes) and ~10 minutes to walk a short runbook for failover and rollback.
- We’d prefer the APAC-first + US repeat cadence (Option A) — gives our APAC engineers a live seat on the exec narrative and lets US teams join the technical repeat without an awkward late-night.
- Sam: if procurement needs an architecture diagram or SOC2 scoping, we can add that as a one-pager to the invite.

One ask: can Kimberly include a 2-slide, bulletized cost/latency summary so we can call out trade-offs during the SI runthrough? Otherwise we’ll run slightly over.

I’m good to lead the tech block — please put me as the primary contact: jake.turner@orbitsi.com

Thanks,
Jake Turner
Senior Solutions Architect, Orbit Systems
